scope: Exploratory original PhysX raw response, NOT validated active policy, deterministic safety certificate, or official upstream
measurements: pre_t2 and pre_t3 achieved EE XYZ
real native arm and gripper command provenance
source reconstructed target XYZ from each of two ACK histories
post_t3 privileged true target XYZ audit ONLY after action
official env success only descriptive, not task policy efficiency
one-step two-truth paired public XYZ separation per probe and robot/seed
primary_descriptive_estimate: for each robot and reset seed, Euclidean public XYZ gap (applied versus held) under same probe; compare nonzero_x minus zero and nonzero_y minus zero with 4 paired seed values per robot
preregistered_pilot_go_no_go: Treat any 5mm or larger public response-gap benefit on >=3 of 4 new reset seeds in BOTH robot bodies as justification for independent calibration followup; otherwise publish a negative/inconclusive pilot; NOT significance or publication proof.
cost_and_dependency: All three probes have four actual physical steps but NOT equal native displacement, motor energy, contact or sensory cost; record arm L2 native amplitude and do NOT claim equal-cost.
forbidden: No data-informed changes to declared fault/probe/seed set
No replacing pilot cases that fail or collide
No deterministic response bounds inferred from eight seeds
No privileged hidden target during diagnosis
No novel VLA task recovery claim
No 48 independent episodes: only eight reset clusters
No zero-vs-nonzero gain if observed null
No claim of physical contact safety
